--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/_pytest/named_mock_count.py
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+# mypy: allow-untyped-defs
+"""Count named mock patch injections for mock audits."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+
+
+def named_mock_count(function) -> int:
+    """Return number of mock patches applied with an attribute name (if any)."""
+    patchings = getattr(function, "patchings", None)
+    if not patchings:
+        return 0
+
+    mock_sentinel = getattr(sys.modules.get("mock"), "DEFAULT", object())
+    ut_mock_sentinel = getattr(sys.modules.get("unittest.mock"), "DEFAULT", object())
+
+    return len(
+        [
+            p
+            for p in patchings
+            if p.attribute_name
+            and (p.new is mock_sentinel or p.new is ut_mock_sentinel)
+        ]
+    )
diff --git a/testing/test_named_mock_count.py b/testing/test_named_mock_count.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..9cf2703c8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_named_mock_count.py
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from unittest import mock
+
+from _pytest.named_mock_count import named_mock_count
+
+
+def test_no_patchings() -> None:
+    def f() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    assert named_mock_count(f) == 0
+    f.patchings = []  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    assert named_mock_count(f) == 0
+
+
+def test_counts_named_default_patches_only() -> None:
+    @mock.patch("os.getcwd")
+    @mock.patch("os.getpid", new=lambda: 1)
+    @mock.patch.multiple("os", getuid=mock.DEFAULT)
+    @mock.patch.multiple("os", getgid=lambda: 1)
+    def f(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    assert named_mock_count(f) == 1
